description: This file defines a Kotlin class 'MatchRepository' that retrieves live sports match data from Firebase Realtime Database or provides mock data for testing. It includes functionalities for observing match updates via Kotlin Flows, handling data parsing, and managing Firebase database references.

classes.name: MatchRepository
classes.description: Repository class responsible for fetching live match data from Firebase, providing real-time updates through Kotlin Flow, or fallback to mock data if Firebase is unavailable.

methods.name: watchMatches
methods.description: Returns a Flow emitting a list of Match objects whenever the Firebase database updates. If Firebase isn't initialized, it provides mock data for testing or development.

methods.name: mockFlow
methods.description: Private helper method that provides a Flow emitting predefined mock Match data to simulate real-time updates.
